question: Which is NOT correct in the context of environmental accidents and their locations?

options.text: Three Mile Island nuclear disaster - Tokyo

solution:
The correct answer is __**Three Mile Island nuclear disaster - Tokyo**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Three Mile Island nuclear disaster occurred in the **United States, not Tokyo.** It happened on **March 28, 1979**, at the Three Mile Island Nuclear Generating Station in Pennsylvania.
